class.name: RosMsg
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 message, with native typed subclasses for the interfaces a project depends on.
class.description: [RosMsg] provides a flexible way to handle ROS 2 messages within Godot. It uses [b]BabelFish[/b] to dynamically translate ROS 2 message buffers into Godot-friendly [Variant] data and vice versa. Fields can be accessed dynamically using [method get_member] and [method set_member], or via Godot's property system if the message has been initialized. [b]Typed classes:[/b] when the extension loads, rclgd registers a native class deriving from [RosMsg] for every interface type provided by the packages listed as dependencies in the project's [code]res://package.xml[/code] (and every type they nest). Messages ([code]msg/[/code]), service requests and responses ([code]srv/[/code], e.g. [code]RosExampleInterfacesSrvAddTwoIntsRequest[/code]) and action goals, results and feedback ([code]action/[/code]) are covered. [code]geometry_msgs/msg/Twist[/code] becomes [code]RosGeometryMsgsTwist[/code], with one typed property per field: nested messages are typed objects and arrays of messages are typed arrays ([code]Array[RosGeometryMsgsPose][/code]). These classes give editor autocomplete and type checking, can be created with [code]new()[/code], and are what [method from_type] and every received message (subscriptions, services, actions) return for their type. Types not registered this way keep working as plain dynamic [RosMsg] instances. A field whose name clashes with a [RosMsg] member or a GDScript keyword is not exposed as a property of the typed class; reach it with [method get_member] and [method set_member]. [b]Note:[/b] the set of typed classes is fixed when the extension loads. After adding a dependency to [code]package.xml[/code], or building a new interface package, reload the project (or restart the game). Exported games need [code]package.xml[/code] in the export preset's non-resource include filter.

method.name: from_type
method.description: Factory method that creates and returns a new message for the given [param ros_type_name] (e.g., [code]"std_msgs/msg/String"[/code]). If the type has a registered typed class, the returned instance is of that class (e.g. [code]RosStdMsgsString[/code]); otherwise it is a dynamic [RosMsg]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the type cannot be resolved.

method.name: get_member
method.description: Returns the value of the message field specified by [param p_name]. If the field is a nested message, it returns another [RosMsg] instance.

method.name: get_ros_interface_name
method.description: Returns the original ROS 2 interface name (e.g., [code]"std_msgs/msg/String"[/code]).

method.name: get_type_name
method.description: Returns the Godot-formatted name of the message type (e.g., [code]"RosStdMsgsString"[/code]). This is the name of the typed class registered for the type, whether or not this instance is of that class.

method.name: init
method.description: Initializes a [RosMsg] created with [code]RosMsg.new()[/code] to represent a message of the specified [param ros_type_name], allocating a new ROS 2 message buffer. Does nothing on an already initialized message (e.g. any typed class instance). The instance stays a dynamic [RosMsg] even when the type has a typed class; use [method from_type] or the class's [code]new()[/code] to get a typed one.

method.name: set_member
method.description: Sets the value of the message field specified by [param p_name] to [param p_value]. The value is automatically converted to the appropriate ROS 2 type. If the field is a nested message, [param p_value] must be a [RosMsg].
